description: Entire verse describing the journey from Hazeroth to Paran. This content is completely missing from OSMAIN v1-v33.

The phrase 'También vimos allí gigantes... y éramos nosotros...' completes the thought started in OSMAIN v32 and includes the full text of OSMAIN v33. While this is a merge, if we strictly look at OSMAIN v32 which ends abruptly ('storvoks'), the translation provides the completion of that sentence plus the next verse's content.

The entire verse 'Y MOISÉS dijo á los hijos de Israel, conforme á todo lo que Jehová le había mandado.' is extra content not found in OSMAIN. OSMAIN begins with Moses speaking to the heads of tribes (v2 equivalent), skipping the introductory address to all Israel.

The text of this verse ('Mas David no pudo ir allá á consultar á Dios...') is identical to the content of OSMAIN verse 30. The translation appears to have split the final narrative block or added an extra verse number for the same event described in OSMAIN v30.

The year of Asa's illness is stated as 'thirty-nine' (39) in the translation, whereas OSMAIN v12 states 'thirty-eight' (38). This discrepancy suggests a textual variant or error that needs to be addressed.
Text about the lion and cubs (Job 38:39-40) is present in translation but missing from OSMAIN.
Continuation of lion/cubs text. Missing from OSMAIN.
Text about the raven (Job 38:41) is present in translation but missing from OSMAIN.
Narrative text: 'And the Lord answered Job...' (Job 39:35/38:1). Missing from OSMAIN.
God's speech to Job. Missing from OSMAIN.
Narrative text: 'And Job answered the Lord...' (Job 40:1/39:36). Missing from OSMAIN.
Conclusion of Job's speech. Missing from OSMAIN.

The entire verse describing God preparing a great fish to swallow Jonah and Jonah being in the belly for three days and three nights is missing from the OSMAIN text. The OSMAIN text starts immediately with the prayer (v2 in translation).
